responsive.phone: FAQ list sits full-width, no side inset panel.
responsive.tablet: Panel gets a rounded inset background (tablet:rounded-card) offset from the section edges (tablet:left-[-22px] tablet:right-[-22px]); questions get a slightly larger type size (tablet:text-faq-q); heading steps to tablet:text-h3-t.
responsive.desktop: Layout switches from stacked to a two-column row (desktop:flex-row desktop:gap-0) with a fixed-width first column (desktop:w-px desktop:flex-1); heading steps to desktop:text-h3; outer padding widens (desktop:px-40).
